dedupe_notes: Compared proposed item, section and normalized displayed price against every existing Menu Items row for SFA licence SE17688L000. The seven existing Premium Angus Beef Burger (Combo) rows were excluded as exact duplicates. E-voucher listings were excluded because they are not menu items. One unrelated existing Hainanese Chicken Rice row was not present on the official page and was not changed. 56 new unique menu rows remain.
limitations: Only Carl’s Jr. SingPost Centre was positively outlet-joined. The page lists other branch names, but that alone does not prove they have the same menu and prices.
Other brand-wide menus were not mapped to SFA branches.
The pickup ordering page can change prices, listed categories and availability without notice.
The capture showed ADD controls for proposed entries; this is not a guarantee of stock or dine-in pricing.
No images were copied or proposed.
